environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB to instance on 8080. Application runs as a systemd service with gunicorn. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume. No request filtering or input sanitization middleware configured.
